bettermoving.gui.title: BetterMoving Configuration
bettermoving.config.comment.ignoreFluidP: Override all local-player fluid movement using the selected Movement model. Non-movement fluid effects remain unchanged. This changes client-side movement prediction only.
bettermoving.config.comment.model: Air rules treat water, lava, and bubble columns as air. Water rules treat them as ordinary water, including swimming in lava while suppressing bubble-column lift and drag. This option only applies while Ignore fluid physics is enabled.
bettermoving.config.comment.virtualPlatf: Create an invisible movement-only floor at your exact feet height when enabled. Walk, sprint, sneak, and jump on it like ordinary ground. Toggle off and on to capture a new height. A new player or dimension captures a fresh height. No world blocks or interaction targets are created; only client movement collision is changed.
bettermoving.config.comment.voidProtecti: Create an invisible movement-only floor at the current world's void damage boundary, 64 blocks below its minimum build height, to prevent the local player from falling into the void. The height is recalculated for each player and world. No world blocks, rendering, interaction targets, or other entities are affected. Disabled and unbound by default.
bettermoving.config.comment.ignoreSprint: Allow normal client-side sprinting at food level 6 or below by treating the food check inside canSprint as full hunger. Actual food, saturation, movement speed, and other sprint requirements stay unchanged. Only affects the local client player.
bettermoving.config.comment.ignoreSlippe: Treat ice and other blocks with above-normal slipperiness as ordinary blocks during local-player movement. Block states, rendering, interactions, and other entities remain unchanged.
bettermoving.config.comment.simulatePoti: Simulate the configured Speed, Jump Boost, and Dolphin's Grace effect levels in local-player movement calculations. The toggle is disabled and unbound by default.
bettermoving.config.comment.overridePoti: When enabled with Simulate potion effects, replace the local player's existing Speed, Jump Boost, and Dolphin's Grace effects with the configured simulated levels. When disabled, stronger existing Speed and Jump Boost levels and any existing Dolphin's Grace effect are preserved. This changes client-side movement only.
bettermoving.config.comment.ignoreLevita: Ignore Levitation's vertical movement and Elytra restrictions and remove Slowness from the local player's movement speed. The real effects, particles, icons, and other non-movement behavior remain unchanged. Disabled and unbound by default.
bettermoving.config.comment.infiniteElyt: While the local player is Elytra gliding, simulate firework-rocket boosts without sending the item-use packet or consuming rockets on the server. Disabled and unbound by default.
bettermoving.config.comment.elytraFirewo: While the local player is Elytra gliding, use a firework rocket on a block or wall for Elytra acceleration instead of the block-use path. With Infinite Elytra fireworks enabled the rocket is simulated locally without consumption; otherwise vanilla item use and consumption are preserved. Disabled and unbound by default.
bettermoving.config.comment.blockNonElyt: Prevent firework launches from blocks or walls unless Elytra gliding with Elytra firework block use enabled. Normal workbench, container, and entity interactions remain available. Blocked launches send no interaction packet, consume no rocket, create no rocket entity, and do not swing the hand. Disabled and unbound by default.
bettermoving.config.comment.simulateElyt: When enabled for the local player, adjust Elytra firework acceleration toward the configured target speed. The target is expressed in meters per second and converted to meters per tick using V / 20. Disabled and unbound by default.
bettermoving.config.comment.simulatedSpe: Use this Speed potion level for horizontal movement when Simulate potion effects is enabled. Level 0 adds no effect; level 1 matches Speed I. Existing stronger Speed effects are preserved. Values range from 0 to 255.
bettermoving.config.comment.simulatedJum: Use this Jump Boost potion level for jumping when Simulate potion effects is enabled. Level 0 adds no effect; level 1 matches Jump Boost I. Existing stronger Jump Boost effects are preserved. Values range from 0 to 255.
bettermoving.config.comment.simulatedDol: Use this Dolphin's Grace effect level for water movement when Simulate potion effects is enabled. Level 0 adds no effect; any level from 1 to 255 matches the vanilla Dolphin's Grace movement behavior. Existing Dolphin's Grace is preserved unless Override existing potion effects is enabled.
bettermoving.config.comment.simulatedEly: Target equilibrium speed for local Elytra firework acceleration when Simulate Elytra firework target speed is enabled. The value is in meters per second, accepts 0 to Double.MAX_VALUE, and defaults to 64 (3.2 meters per tick).
